title: Lake Tahoe Restoration Reauthorization Act
official_summary:
Lake Tahoe Restoration Reauthorization Act

This act reauthorizes through September 30, 2034, activities to restore Lake Tahoe and its surrounding basin. Lake Tahoe is a large freshwater lake on the border of California and Nevada.

summary.headline: Law extends federal programs to restore Lake Tahoe and its surrounding basin through September 30, 2034.
summary.what_it_does: This law renews the authority for federal activities that restore Lake Tahoe and the land around it, called the Lake Tahoe Basin. Lake Tahoe is a large freshwater lake on the border of California and Nevada. The renewed authority lasts through September 30, 2034. The official summary does not describe specific projects or funding amounts.

who_it_affects.group: People who live in the Lake Tahoe Basin in California and Nevada
who_it_affects.how: Federal restoration work in the area where they live can continue through 2034.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies working in the Lake Tahoe area
who_it_affects.how: Their authority to carry out restoration activities in the basin is extended through September 30, 2034.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted October 1, 2024; authorization runs through September 30, 2034.
